findings.message: Retained from the completed T04 review: the runtime reference describes immutable legacy-baseline upgrade but still does not state that an anchorless legacy run with an active hook cannot be upgraded because the legacy digest did not record hook mode or symlink-referent identity. This remains a documentation-only limitation allocated to later reference cleanup and does not affect T04F cancellation correctness.

summary: T04F passes independent review at frozen snapshot a0f9aafd948b2b2a1ce6d9432b01d70c3f0941f4aea102da7b8d2799e490c866. The cancellation operation binds the exact pending token and run revision, prepared parent and ref, clean index, protected Git anchor and cumulative scope before archiving the complete preparation separately from adopted history. Pending preparations block state-changing Execution transitions and all correction kinds before durable writes or counter spending, while a byte-stable same-state transition remains a no-op. Fresh-process cancellation, reconciliation, reprepare, adoption and finish are covered by real disposable-repository tests, and the coordinator's full npm test and validation gates passed at the same snapshot.
